### Headline figure: genuine backtracks per question (raw counts)

Direct comparison of the unsteered baseline (gc at magnitude $0$) vs. the 
optimal-magnitude steered cell (gc at peak $m$), per architecture. Bigger 
paired bar = the architecture's mined feature direction actually causes 
more genuine backtracking events when steered. Error bars are bootstrap 95% 
CIs over the 61 cohort questions ($n_{\text{boot}} = 1000$).

![gc at peak vs baseline (paired)](c7_paper_assets/gc_at_peak_paired.png)

## Inducement curves: $\Delta gc$ vs steering magnitude

Solid lines are batch-size 1024 cells (headline); dashed lines are the 
additional batch-size 256 cells run for the two TXC architectures (see

## Detection: PR-AUC + ROC-AUC

Sparse-probe PR-AUC and ROC-AUC at top-$S$ feature counts ($5$-fold GroupKFold by 
question, $\ell_1$-regularised logistic regression, $C = 1$). PR-AUC chance $\approx 0.12$ 
(positive-class prior); ROC-AUC chance $= 0.5$.

![Detection metrics at S=8 (PR-AUC + ROC-AUC)](c7_paper_assets/probe_metrics_S8_bar.png)
